_comment: S4 (spec/rules/selection.md). `modules` is the protected set the basename-contains-selection matcher cannot see. Path-shaped entries must hold a live timer (GA6); bare-basename items are fail-closed matcher patterns (caretPositions), not paths. Basename `selection` is a fail-closed net so selectionReader.ts cannot silently escape. `outOfScope` is a decision that a file is not a selection module — not a waiver. `entries` waive a live timer in an in-scope file; each needs file, enclosing symbol, kind, and a reason that names why the site remains. Remove an entry in the same PR that deletes the call. Liveness checks the named symbol and kind, not merely the path.

outOfScope.reason: Pointer-selection gestures, not the selection engine. Split from contentGestures.ts (FE5); that file sat outside the S4 basename net. It holds no timers: multi-click completion runs in a scheduler read (FE3).
